author: cens0r3d
short: Red-DiscordBot cogs: voice status, mic watch, stream alerts, voice messages, username OSINT, passive OSINT and an idle RPG.
description: Red-DiscordBot cogs by cens0r3d: vcstatus keeps voice channel statuses in sync with member counts, micwatch moves members who leave their microphone open for too long, kickalerts posts Kick.com livestream announcements, voicesay sends audio attachments as native Discord voice messages, naminter enumerates usernames across 700+ sites with the WhatsMyName dataset, osint answers passive questions about IPs, domains, ASN, URLs and files from key-free public sources, and idlerpg turns a server into an idle RPG in the spirit of idlerpg.net.
